next_search_hypothesis: The policy under iter_006 achieves 40% success-like terminal rate, 0% timeout, but 60% unsafe terminal rate. The dominant component is crash_penalty (-50) with dominance_ratio 4.53. The policy reaches the ground with both legs contacting (60% both_leg_contact_rate) but fails to stabilize on the pad (0% stable_touchdown_rate, 0% near_pad_rate). The final states show the lander is far from the pad (|x| > 0.25) with high angle (up to 0.57 rad) or high lateral velocity (up to -0.099). The crash_penalty at -50 is necessary and should not be reduced (negative edge from iter_007). The next edit should add phase-specific guidance for the final touchdown phase: a small bonus for being near the pad (|x|<0.1, y<0.2) with both legs contacting and low lateral velocity (|vx|<0.1), but NOT a timeout penalty, NOT a success_bonus scale increase, NOT an angle relaxation, and NOT a conditional fuel_penalty. The bonus should be event-gated (one-shot) to prevent farming. The scale should be small (e.g., 5-10) to bridge the gap between near-success and true success without causing the out_of_bounds behavior seen in iter_002. The crash_penalty must remain at -50. The fuel_penalty must remain at -0.05 (unconditional). The success_bonus conditions must remain unchanged (|angle|<0.1, |x|<0.1, y<0.2, |vx|<0.1, |vy|<0.1).

strategy_rationale: The search has converged on iter_006 as the best provisional anchor: 40% success-like terminal rate, 0% timeout, 60% unsafe. The fuel_penalty halving from -0.1 to -0.05 (iter_005->iter_006) was the only successful edit so far, dramatically improving timeout behavior and doubling success rate. All other edits (timeout penalties, angle relaxation, conditional fuel_penalty, near_pad_bonus, success_bonus increase, crash_penalty reduction) caused regression to early failure. The next edit must be conservative: add a small, event-gated near-pad bonus (5-10) that rewards the policy for reaching the pad area with both legs contacting and low lateral velocity, without changing any other component. This directly addresses the current bottleneck: the policy reaches the ground but fails to stabilize on the pad. The bonus must be one-shot to prevent farming, and must not be combined with any other changes. The crash_penalty must remain at -50 (negative edge from iter_007). The fuel_penalty must remain at -0.05 unconditional (positive reference from iter_006). The success_bonus conditions must remain unchanged (negative edges from iter_002, iter_003, iter_004, iter_005 all involved angle relaxation or scale increase).
